headline: India’s telecom regulator opens consultation on responsible AI-use guidelines
summary: On 30 October 2026, India’s Telecom Regulatory Authority (TRAI) released a draft titled Guidelines on Responsible Use of Artificial Intelligence in Telecommunication Networks and Provision of Telecommunication Services for public comment. TRAI’s official consultation record lists the proposal as open and gives 27 November 2026 as the comment deadline. The press release frames it as sector guidance intended to align telecom practice with India’s AI Governance Guidelines. The detailed draft text was linked from TRAI’s consultation page but was not retrieved for this review, so its specific proposed duties, legal force and implementation are not assessed.
